name: Re:Store the Record Store
summary: Re:Store the Record Store is a game about tidying up an indie record store after the owner had to run off to chase down his escaped monkey. Featuring over 1000 items to pick up, sort through and return back into the crates where they belong. Take your time to look through everything or speedrun it!
